question: What was the result of the T20I series (March 2021) between India and England Men's cricket team?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India won 3-2**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India won** the** fifth **and** final T20I **by** 36 runs**, to win the **series 3–2. India **won the first **ODI by 66 runs**, with **England **winning the** second ODI by six wickets** to level the series ahead of the final ODI of the tour.
 
• The **venue **for all the matches was **Narendra Modi Stadium,** popularly known as **Motera Stadium **in **Ahmedabad.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Award winners__ **​

 
 
• Man of the match in 5th T20I -** Bhuvneshwar Kumar**
 
• Player of the series - **Virat Kohli**
